About Strada

Strada is building the operating layer for AI-driven insurance.

Our platform deploys expert AI agents across calls, texts, emails, and chat - running core front-office workflows from policy servicing to claims intake. With a singular focus on insurance, Strada offers domain expertise and product depth that generic AI platforms can't match.

Backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors, Strada already automates more than 1M customer interactions for leading insurers, MGAs, and brokers representing $20B+ in annual premiums. Adoption is accelerating across the industry.

Insurance is one of the largest and most complex industries in the world, and modern AI has the potential to fundamentally reshape how it operates. Strada is replacing fragmented workflows with AI-native infrastructure that runs real operations at scale - at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and highly regulated real-world systems.

We're a small, high-ownership team based in San Francisco, already embedded in production systems at sophisticated insurance organizations. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and shape the future of a massive industry, let's meet.

 

Why Insurance?

Insurance quietly powers the global economy - it helps businesses stay open, families recover from disasters, and entire industries manage risk. But the way insurance operates hasn't changed in decades. Many frontline workflows still rely on phone calls and legacy systems.

We're building AI that plugs into those workflows and makes them radically faster, smarter, and more efficient. It's a $300B+ market ripe for innovation.

 

The Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join as one of our earliest engineering hires. You'll work across the stack to build the core systems that power our AI agents – from real-time voice infrastructure to integrations with insurance platforms.

This is a high-impact role where you'll ship production code from day one, learn fast, and grow alongside the company.

 

What you'll get done in the first week

 - Ship your first PR to production (on the first day) - no months of onboarding, you're contributing from day one

 - Get hands-on with our voice AI stack and understand how we're automating thousands of insurance calls daily

 - Meet the team, shadow customer calls, and see exactly how your code impacts real users

What you'll do in your first 30 days

 - Own a feature end-to-end - from scoping to shipping - that directly improves how our AI agents handle customer conversations

 - Optimize live systems handling real insurance workflows for major carriers

 - Start building intuition for the insurance domain and understand why this $1T+ industry is ripe for AI

What you'll do in your first 90 days

 - Take ownership of a core product area and drive meaningful improvements independently

 - Contribute to launches that land in front of customers - not internal tools that sit on a shelf

 - Have a real seat at the table on product and technical decisions at a company that just went from $0 to $3M ARR in 18 months
   
    

What You'll Need

 - Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design

 - Experience building software in internships, coursework, or personal projects

 - Comfort working across the stack – we use TypeScript, React, and Node.js

 - Thrive in fast-moving, high-ownership environments
   
    

Nice to Have

 - Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, or telephony

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM-based platforms or prompt engineering

 - Prior experience at an early-stage startup

 - Contributions to open source projects
   
    

What We Offer

 - Competitive salary

 - Macbook Pro, 4K display and all the accessories

 - Regular team events & offsites

 - Daily team dinners provided (Mon–Fri)

 - Gym membership

 

**IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is on-site at our San Francisco office

role: AI Workflows & Safety Decision Making Intern \[2027\]
jd:
In this Role, You Will…:
• Develop AI-Powered Decision Tools: Design, prototype, and implement agentic workflows and AI-assisted tools that automate complex safety evaluations and triage operational signals. 

• Test & Validate Tool Reliability: Characterize the capabilities, edge cases, and failure modes of LLMs and AI workflows to ensure decision aids operate within safety-critical reliability thresholds. 

• Integrate Data Pipelines: Connect generative AI agents to structured safety databases and operational logs to automate real-time synthesis and risk reporting. 

• Collaborate Across Safety & Software: Work alongside safety strategists and software engineers to test prototypes in real operational scenarios and iterate based on user feedback.

Internship Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree (or advanced degree) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Data Science, or related engineering field. 

• Good academic standing and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship. 

• Expected graduation date between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028. 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship. 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship. 

• Interns at Zoox may not use proprietary information for thesis or publication outside of Zoox.

Technical Qualifications :
• Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and object-oriented programming. 

• Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI tools, LLM APIs, and agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude/Cursor environments). 

• Critical understanding of the limitations, hallucinations, and verification methods required when deploying AI in decision-making contexts. 

• Experience building working prototypes, APIs, or internal web dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, FastAPI, or Flask). 

• Strong analytical problem-solving and clear written/verbal technical communication.

Bonus Qualifications:
• Prior experience applying AI/ML techniques to autonomous systems, safety analytics, or risk management. 

• Experience designing evaluation harnesses to benchmark generative AI and prompt performance. 

• Familiarity with database architectures (SQL/NoSQL) and data warehousing platforms.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

 Software Engineer - Intern (TikTok BRIC) - 2027 Start (PhD)

 Location :
 San Jose

 Employment Type :
 Intern

 Job Code :
 A149779

 Apply to this job Share this listing:

 Responsibilities
 "Business Risk Integrated Control (BRIC) is a global team protecting ByteDance users, platform health, and the authenticity of community and business ecosystems. We build the risk control algorithms, AI technologies, platforms, and infrastructure behind that work, across products including TikTok, CapCut, Lemon8, and Lark.

Our work spans account and content integrity, and safety across advertising and e-commerce. We apply machine learning across areas such as graph learning, anomaly detection, and multimodal models to understand users, content, behavior, and the relationships between them. The challenge is recognizing genuine activity accurately, so the people using our products never notice the systems working.

You will shape the trust, safety, and sustainable growth of ByteDance's global platforms, applying advanced AI to some of the hardest real-world problems in the field."

Program Intern (Conversion-Oriented): for graduating students who are looking for full-time conversion as the primary objective.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. PhD internships at Our Company provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, as well as to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.
Our dynamic internship experience blends hands-on learning, enriching community-building and professional development events, and collaboration with industry experts.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume (Start date, End date).

Responsibilities: 
- Engine performance, continuously improved by Agents: Build agent workflows that profile the risk engine, identify performance bottlenecks (latency, CPU, memory, cost), propose and verify optimizations, and detect performance regressions. Explore RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement) loops — propose, benchmark, evaluate, iterate — so optimization becomes a sustained, closed-loop process rather than one-off tuning.
- Proactive rule governance by Agents: Design agents that actively audit the rule base across its lifecycle — detecting redundant, conflicting, expired, or low-value rules, analyzing online impact, and generating safe change or decommission proposals with human-in-the-loop approval, rollback, and audit trails.
- Agent platform and evaluation foundations: Contribute to the shared capabilities these agents depend on: tool use and workflow orchestration, evaluation benchmarks and guardrails, observability, and safety controls — and take prototypes to production landing with measurable impact.

 Qualifications
 Minimum Qualifications: 
- Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline. 
- Solid programming skills, proficient in one of the languages (Python / Go / C++ / Java), with good software engineering practices.
- Strong foundation in machine learning and data analysis; rigorous experimental methodology — defining metrics, running controlled comparisons, and drawing defensible conclusions.
- Strong sense of ownership, proactive, and effective in communication; able to work in an English-speaking, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Research or engineering experience in LLM agents, self-improving / self-evolving systems (RSI), automated code or performance optimization, program synthesis, or reinforcement learning; Publications at top venues are a plus.
- Experience with large-scale backend or infrastructure systems — performance profiling and optimization, distributed systems, rule engines, feature / factor platforms, or risk control systems.
- Experience building agent evaluation, observability, or safety / guardrail mechanisms for production LLM systems.
- Open-source contributions, competition results, or prior research internships in related areas.
- Hands-on experience of building with LLMs/Agents is a big plus — e.g., tool and function calling, RAG, multi-step agent workflows, prompt and context engineering — through research, projects, or prior internships.

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy
